name: microscope
description: Read JVM profiles from a running Jeffrey Microscope — list analysed recordings, query their DuckDB tables, and pull flamegraph, trace and heap-dump exports without leaving the terminal.

endpoint_url.title: Jeffrey MCP endpoint
endpoint_url.description: URL of the Microscope MCP endpoint. Keep the default for a Jeffrey on its usual port; change it for another port, a container or an SSH tunnel. Settings → Claude Code (MCP) shows the exact URL for your installation.
